rationale: Revised plan addresses target leakage by restricting features to submission-time attributes only. Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount (post-submission financial fields unavailable when scoring new incoming claims) and high_cost_flag (target-derived). Retained claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, service_units, and length_of_stay as they are available at claim intake. This eliminates information leakage that inflated prior ROC-AUC values (0.9969, 0.9972) to unrealistic levels. With valid features only, models will produce metrics in the expected 0.6-0.95 range. Added no_operational_use caveat to report to prevent deployment without clinical validation. Preprocessing fitted on training data exclusively maintains statistical discipline. Logistic regression provides interpretability; gradient boosting provides tree-based ranking capability.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage; models will now use submission-time features only (claim characteristics, service context, provider attributes). Added no_operational_use to report caveats to prevent operational deployment without clinical sign-off.
